links.outcome: Physician non-adherence to AI recommendations and physician characteristics associated with following them
links.effect: ~33% of physicians did not follow UTIS recommendations; older physicians (OR 1.034/yr), Arabic sector (OR 3.474), and higher patient volume (OR 1.027 per 100) were less likely to follow.
links.quote: UTIS reduced antibiotic mismatch-defined as pathogen resistance to prescribed empiric antibiotic based on culture-by ~ 30%, yet ~ 33% of physicians did not follow its recommendations.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of physician adoption patterns and adherence following the real-world deployment of an AI-driven clinical decision support system for UTI management.
